user.title: Sky Background
user.description: Pick the weather entity that drives the background and the weather effects. Everything else can be tuned later in the integration options.

data_description.temperature_entity: Used for the rain-to-snow conversion. If empty, the temperature of the weather entity is used.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Sky Background is already set up.

data.rain_to_snow: Turn rain into snow when it is cold
data.rain_to_snow_temp: Snow at or below this temperature

data_description.rain_to_snow: Some weather providers report rain at around 0 °C.

periods.title: Time-of-day periods
periods.description: Sunrise, midday and evening are computed from the sun. Adjust how long each one lasts.

data.sunrise_before_min: Sunrise starts before the sun rises
data.sunrise_after_min: Sunrise lasts after the sun rises
data.midday_half_width_min: Midday: minutes either side of solar noon

data.heavy_rain_multiplier: Extra density for heavy rain and storms
data.stars: Stars on clear evenings and nights
data.show_moon: Draw the moon (with its real phase)
data.use_real_clouds: Cloud amount from the weather entity (cloud coverage)
data.use_real_wind: Wind speed and direction from the weather entity
data.sky_time_offset_min: Time offset for the sun and moon
data.precip_max_height: Rain and snow fall down to

data_description.layer: Behind the cards works on standard Home Assistant dashboards. If it can't find the dashboard background it falls back to above.
data_description.show_sun: The sun and moon follow their real position for your Home Assistant location. Clouds, wind and haze use the weather entity when it provides them.
data_description.sky_path: Arc crosses the screen from rise to set in any season. Compass follows the real direction.
data_description.sky_time_offset_min: Shifts the sun and moon in time, for example to preview sunset. Positions use the exact time and the Home Assistant location, so the time zone and daylight saving are already handled.
data_description.global_opacity: Scales every effect and the background glow at once. The other opacity sliders fine-tune on top of it.
data_description.precip_max_height: How far down rain, snow and hail fall. 100% is the full screen.
data_description.sky_height: How much of the screen, from the top, the sky takes. The sun, moon, stars and clouds are spread inside it. 50% is the default. Raise it to bring the clouds and the horizon lower, lower it to keep everything near the top.

data.pause_when_hidden: Pause when the tab is hidden
data.auto_reduce_weak_devices: Halve the effects on weak devices

data.everywhere: Also on other pages (history, map, settings…)
data.only_theme_names: Only when one of these themes is selected (comma separated, empty = always)

data_description.dashboards: For example: lovelace, dashboard-new. Used with include and exclude.

data_description.background_mode: Auto sets the background only when your theme or dashboard has none, otherwise it draws a light overlay. Your theme and cards are never changed.
data_description.overlay_intensity: How strong the glows are when drawn as an overlay.

error.dashboards_required: Enter at least one dashboard URL path.

override.name: Override
override.description: Force a period and/or an effect for a while, to preview the look.

clear_override.name: Clear override
clear_override.description: Go back to the real time of day and weather.
